exposure: 5 patients having MTX+UAE+hysteroscopy assisted lesion resection
10 patients undergoing MTX with ultrasound assisted uterine curettage plus uterine artery embolization (UAE)
5 cases receiving Methotrexate (MTX) followed by ultrasound assisted uterine curettage
cohort: 21 Cesarean Scar Pregnancy (CSP) patients admitted from June 2010 to December 2014
finding: Different approaches to treating CSP, chosen based on individual patient conditions, were effective and safe, with all 20 patients who kept their uterus having normal menstrual cycles.
